The spectators watched the track with 
great anticipation for the stellar lineup 
gathered at the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

Tosen Jordan's friends watch the track, 
praying that all her hard work will 
finally bear fruit.

And Tosen Jordan passionately tells her 
Trainer that she's going to run a race 
that will overwrite every trend and 
rewrite history itself.

With this body forged through all her 
training up to now. Putting everything she 
has learned to use in her own way.

"I'm off to pull off the greatest 
stupidity ever, so keep dreaming until the 
very end," she said.
